events.verdict: Grimes (DAL) brings both hands to the ball and dislodges it from Collins' (UTA) grasp after his gather. The arm contact with Collins' left arm occurs after the dislodge and is considered incidental.
Doncic (DAL) rests and removes his off-hand from Filipowski's (UTA) side as he stops his forward momentum and the contact at the end of the drive is marginal.
Grimes (DAL) slides his hand off the ball and makes illegal contact with Clarkson's (UTA) right arm during his driving shot attempt.
Sexton (UTA) momentarily brings his right arm around Lively II's (DAL) side as he attempts to disengage from the offensive player and the contact is marginal.
Lively II (DAL) backs towards the baseline and he comes together with Sexton (UTA) at the same spot on the floor. The contact as the two players disengage is marginal.
Collins (UTA) establishes himself in Grimes' (DAL) path and he does not deliver any illegal contact when setting the pick.
Lively II (DAL) cleanly blocks the shot attempt prior to when the ball reaches its apex.
George (UTA) legally contests Thompson's (DAL) jump shot attempt.
Livelly II (DAL) raises his arm up and brushes Collins' (UTA) arm during the dunk attempt at the basket.
Doncic (DAL) firms up over his right leg and marginal contact occurs with George (UTA) as he defends over the screen.
Sexton (UTA) and Doncic (DAL) briefly engage and disengage during the throw-in.
Clarkson (UTA) avoids making any illegal contact with Marshall (DAL) during his contest of Marshall's (DAL) jump shot attempt.
